title: Uttarakhand Congress protests appointment of Sikkim governor in Dehradun

tea.why: Uttarakhand Congress protested the appointment of Dushyant Kumar Gautam as Sikkim governor, alleging his ties to the Ankita Bhandari case.
tea.want: Demanded to put the gubernatorial appointment on hold until the investigation into the Ankita Bhandari murder case is complete.
tea.changed: Oct 15: Police detained multiple Uttarakhand Congress leaders including former Chief Minister Harish Rawat during a protest outside Lok Bhawan.

summary: The Uttarakhand Congress organised demonstrations in Dehradun to oppose the appointment of Dushyant Kumar Gautam as the governor of Sikkim. Party members alleged that Gautam's name had been linked to the 2022 Ankita Bhandari murder case by the victim's parents, and claimed the appointment was a move to shield him from legal scrutiny. The protests began with a silent demonstration near the Gandhi statue led by state Congress committee president Ganesh Godiyal. The demonstrations continued outside the Lok Bhawan where protesters demanded the appointment be suspended pending completion of the murder probe. Authorities responded by detaining numerous senior party leaders and approximately 50 individuals.
demands: Put the appointment of Dushyant Kumar Gautam as Sikkim governor on hold
Complete the investigation into the Ankita Bhandari murder case
response: According to The Hindu, police detained several senior Congress leaders and around 50 people during the protest outside the Lok Bhawan in Dehradun.

updates.text: Uttarakhand Congress leaders observed a one-hour silence at Gandhi Park in Dehradun against the Sikkim governor appointment.
Uttarakhand Congress staged a protest outside Lok Bhawan in Dehradun, resulting in the detention of about 50 individuals including senior leaders.
